locator: Explanations sheet: what the line owners wrote about October and the year to date
name: E07 Variance Explanations
rows: Pad 22, Phase 5 closing moved to November 6 when the purchaser's lender extended its loan commitment. Earnest money was received October 31.
Follows the Pad 22 closing moving to November.
Compact track loader rented for the Phase 5 storm repairs after the October 18 storm (AER-7731). Not in the budget.
Replacement laptops and a large-format plotter for the Phase 5 site office (NOS-5521). One-time; approved by the Controller September 29.
September's duplicate amortization is reversed in October (close entry AJ-01). Below the threshold; noted for the reader.
Commission follows the Pad 22 closing moving to November.
